welcome.title: OIDC Login - Home Assistant
welcome.device_instructions: Please login to Home Assistant on another device and enter this code when asked:
welcome.device_wait_hint: The login will continue automatically when you complete the login on your other device. Please keep the app open.

finish.title: Logged in! - Home Assistant
finish.heading: Logged in!
finish.continue_text: Tap Continue to login to Home Assistant on this device.
finish.device_code_heading: Use a code from another device
finish.device_code_text: On your other device, open the Home Assistant app. You will see a 6-digit code.
finish.device_code_input_text: Input that code here and click Approve to login on the other device.
finish.approve_button: Approve login on the other device

device_success.title: Done! - Home Assistant
device_success.heading: Success!
device_success.message: You have successfully logged in on your mobile device. It should continue the login soon.
device_success.logged_out: You have been logged out on this device.

messages.missing_state_cookie: Missing state cookie, please restart login.
messages.state_mismatch: State parameter does not match, possible CSRF attack.
messages.user_details_failed: Failed to get user details, see Home Assistant logs for more information.
messages.user_not_in_group: User is not in the correct group to access Home Assistant, contact your administrator!
messages.save_user_info_failed: Failed to save user information, session probably expired. Please sign in again.
messages.device_link_failed: Failed to link state to device code, please restart login.
messages.device_code_failed: Failed to generate device code, please restart login.
messages.misconfigured: Integration is misconfigured, discovery could not be obtained.
